title: Honeywell Technologies Unveils New EBI, Fire and Life Safety and Security Innovations That Bring More Intelligent, Autonomous Operations to Buildings
summary: Accelerate 2026 showcases new AI-powered building intelligence via EBI One, as well as the expansion of Honeywell Technologies’ fire and life safety product capabilities for early detection, nuisance alarm reduction and smarter responses Additional innovations set to be introduced throughout 2027
